QuestionStmt.S:
Identify the product 'B' in the following sequence of reactions.

Methylpropanoate $\xrightarrow[\text{dil. NaOH}]{\Delta}$ A $\xrightarrow[\text{Conc. HCl}]{\text{H}^+}$ B

Solution.S: Methylpropanoate (CH₃CH₂COOCH₃) undergoes alkaline hydrolysis (saponification) with dilute NaOH on heating to form sodium propanoate (A) and methanol. Then treatment with concentrated HCl (H⁺) converts sodium propanoate into propanoic acid (B). Thus B is propanoic acid, which corresponds to option D.
